ui.whenYouCreateAnAccount_07f6a: When you create an account, your email address and display name are stored. During use, your favorite routes, visited stops, comments, and shared photos are stored. Guests are not asked to provide personal data.
ui.pageViewsAreCountedAnonymously_d2b4f: Page views are counted anonymously without cookies, using only the page path and a random identifier specific to the session. Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights also collect aggregate measurements that do not identify you. Measurement is disabled when “Do Not Track” is enabled in your browser.
ui.onlyTheSiteAdministratorCan_92660: Only the site administrator can see your feedback and any contact details you choose to provide. During a group tour, your name and live location are shared in real time only with members using the same group code. They are not stored.
ui.yourLiveLocationOnThe_3790d: Your live location on the map is used only with your permission and on your device. It is not stored on our servers.
ui.dataIsUsedOnlyTo_edef6: Data is used only to operate the app. It is not sold to third parties or shared for advertising. Infrastructure providers are Supabase for the database and authentication, and Vercel for hosting.
ui.youMayRequestThatYour_c9b34: You may request that your account and data be deleted or corrected. You can contact the app owner by email to make a request.
ui.aFreeDigitalGuideFor_cb532: A free digital guide for visitors to Afyonkarahisar, with sourced stop descriptions, planned routes, a map with live directions, an audio guide, and group tours.
ui.whereDoesTheInformationCome_122a3: Where does the information come from?
ui.stopDescriptionsAndRoutesAre_a100b: Stop descriptions and routes are compiled from official publications and academic sources. Sources are listed on each stop page. Photos are provided through Wikimedia Commons under the licenses specified by their owners.
ui.useTheFeedbackPageTo_a6ac8: Use the Feedback page to report incorrect or missing information, suggest a stop or route, contribute a photo, or make a complaint. Every message is read.
ui.createACodeBySelecting_5b418: Create a code by selecting “Group tour” on a route page and send it to your friends. Everyone can see each other live on the map. When the guide advances to the next stop, the group moves together.
